answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if the agent is caught faking work or reviews. One fake identity is cheap, but a Sybil army needs a thousand stakes, so the attacker cost grows linearly with each fake while honest agents get their stake back untouched. A jade seal on each wallet makes the bond verifiable, a shared oasis of staked traders keeps honest deals flowing, and a walnut-shell game of free throwaway identities collapses once every shell costs real money.
